NBC fixtures trimmed from the public results feed used by NBC's results pages.
Not a documented API; the adapter is a scraper and disabled by default.

- 2024-results.json: https://www.nbcnews.com/firecracker/api/v2/national-results/2024-elections/senate-results
  Trimmed to four mapData entries (TX/AZ Senate, TX-38 House, DE Governor),
  candidate names/parties/winner flags only.
